module_summary: AXI-lite instruction fetch unit: issues incrementing AR requests throttled by outstanding/fill counters, buffers 64-bit read data in an sfifo, and shifts out 32-bit instructions with PC tracking and flush on new PC.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AXI read address valid; issued unless fetch limit, full bus, or reset throttles requests

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Fetch address: loads i_pc or pending_pc, else increments per bus word

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Slave accepts read address; advances ARADDR, clears flush_request, counts outstanding

anchors.name: M_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid; writes FIFO and decrements outstanding/flushcount

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: 64-bit read data, endian-swapped and pushed into fetch FIFO

anchors.name: i_new_pc
anchors.why: CPU branch request: resets FIFO, reloads ARADDR and o_pc from i_pc

anchors.name: i_clear_cache
anchors.why: Clears fetch FIFO and pending PC, suppresses ARVALID

anchors.name: i_pc
anchors.why: New program counter loaded into ARADDR, pending_pc and o_pc

anchors.name: o_insn
anchors.why: Instruction output, low word of out_data shift register

anchors.name: o_valid
anchors.why: Instruction valid to CPU; set from FIFO read or remaining out_fill words

anchors.name: i_ready
anchors.why: CPU accepts instruction; shifts out_data, decrements out_fill, advances o_pc

anchors.name: o_pc
anchors.why: Address of current instruction; loaded on new PC, increments on accept

anchors.name: o_illegal
anchors.why: Bus error flag latched from RRESP bit stored in FIFO data

anchors.name: outstanding
anchors.why: Counts outstanding AXI reads; drives full_bus and flushcount

anchors.name: full_bus
anchors.why: Outstanding count at limit; blocks new ARVALID

anchors.name: fill
anchors.why: Requests issued but not consumed; throttles ARVALID against FETCH_LIMIT

anchors.name: flushcount
anchors.why: Number of stale responses to discard after a PC change

anchors.name: flushing
anchors.why: Discarding stale read responses; blocks FIFO writes

anchors.name: flush_request
anchors.why: Pending AR during flush; prevents counting it in fill

anchors.name: pending_new_pc
anchors.why: New PC arrived while AR stalled; selects pending_pc for ARADDR

anchors.name: pending_pc
anchors.why: Holds new PC until AR channel can accept it

anchors.name: fifo_wr
anchors.why: FIFO write when read data valid and not flushing

anchors.name: fifo_rd
anchors.why: Pops FIFO word into out_data when output empty or last insn taken

anchors.name: fifo_empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty; gates o_valid, out_fill and o_illegal updates

anchors.name: fifo_data
anchors.why: FIFO output word with error bit, loaded into out_data

anchors.name: out_data
anchors.why: Shift register of fetched word, shifts out one instruction per accept

anchors.name: out_fill
anchors.why: Remaining instructions in out_data word; controls fifo_rd and o_valid

anchors.name: shift
anchors.why: Instruction offset within bus word from o_pc low bits

anchors.name: endian_swapped_rdata
anchors.why: Byte-swapped read data written into fetch FIFO

groups.name: AXI read request controller
groups.description: Issues incrementing AR requests, throttled by outstanding and fill counts

groups.name: Flush logic
groups.description: Discards stale responses after PC change, resets fetch FIFO

groups.name: Fetch FIFO
groups.description: sfifo buffering endian-swapped read words with error bit

groups.name: Instruction output stage
groups.description: Shifts instructions out of bus word, tracks PC and bus error
